description: Writes three short AI coaching scripts for an exercise's audio instructions, in the language you choose. Use when the user wants cue lines, voice-over text or audio instructions for an exercise. Not for exercise names, tags or muscle groups (use update_exercise_metadata). Returns three scripts as text; nothing is saved to the exercise.

exercise_id.description: ID of the exercise. Get it from list_team_exercises or list_uploads_to_review.

locale.description: Language and region for the scripts, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE", "es-ES". Defaults to "en-US".

muscle_groups.description: Muscle group names to base the scripts on, e.g. ["Chest", "Triceps"]. Omit to use the exercise's own muscle groups.

tone_preset.description: Coaching tone for the scripts, e.g. energetic_motivational for a hype voice. Omit for a neutral tone.

name: generate_exercise_audio
title: Generate exercise audio scripts
